text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Dis Earth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The world is truly worldwide. Races aren't 
just held in this country, but all across 
the globe. And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Beyond this sea lies the stage where I, 
Seeking the Pearl, will show my infinite 
potential!
(BOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Wouldn't you agree that 
keeping my pearl-like potential confined 
within the country would be such a waste?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Because! I'm gonna run in the Twinkle 
Series and win race after race! Then, I'll 
take on the world!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is my grand plan♪ The inborn Destiny 
that I was meant to fulfill!

My trainee, Seeking the Pearl. An 
American-born Umamusume brimming with 
confidence and boasting extraordinary 
speed.

She's the type to talk a really big game, 
setting huge goals like taking on the 
world. But...

I know the truth. She isn't just some 
conceited show-off or a clown.

Behind the "grand ambition" that seemed 
almost comical, Seeking the Pearl's true, 
hidden goal was—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heheh, isn't it obvious? It's—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"It's to 'banish the despair' of all the 
people around the world unable to dream, 
whom I have seen with my own eyes!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When the broadcast shows me overcoming 
every hardship to seize victory, it will 
become a universal message to the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Through my running, the lands of the world 
will become one! The six continents! All 
the islands! Spanning a rainbow of 
possibility!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is—why I don't rely solely on talent. 
Why I dare to challenge the impossible. 
—Understand?

By challenging the impossible, she's 
trying to bring courage to people all over 
the world.

Her running talent was top-notch, but... 
above all, what made me want to team up 
with her was the loftiness of her 
ambition.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. This is no time to be 
mesmerized by my fabulousness.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Let's head right back to Tracen Academy 
and hammer out the fine details. Let's 
brief!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First, the grand objective. You know what 
realistic goal I'm aiming for, don't you, 
Trainer?

âA realistic grand goal. The most 
straightforward achievement to prove our 
potential to the world would be...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a triangle... That's a 'maybe'. That 
answer isn't a yes or a no.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Among all the overseas G1s, what I aim for 
is a feat deemed impossible. Namely—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A "European G1 Victory"!

—A European GⅠ victory. That was a 
long-cherished wish, and an unfulfilled 
dream for the Umamusume of Tracen Academy.

European turf courses have different types 
of grass and groundbeds. It demands 
tremendous toughness, and on top of 
that...

Forced to race in an unfamiliar 
environment, many illustrious Umamusume 
have been brought down before.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is, truly, the impossible! A grand 
feat worthy of achievement. And—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"My soul tells me so... That securing our 
first European GⅠ victory is my destined 
path!"

A promised destiny... Seeking the Pearl 
seems to yearn for a European GⅠ victory 
so intensely that one can't help but feel 
it as such.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, goals are set. But European G1s 
cover quite a wide range of distances, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, tell me. Through those eyes of 
yours, what does my optimal distance look 
like to you?

—Her ideal distance. There's no doubt that 
Seeking the Pearl's speed is unmatched. 
However...

She isn't just an Umamusume with speed. I 
could tell she has tremendous versatility 
and range as well.
choice_data_list: I think you can handle up to 2,000m.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Right, 2000m is no problem... Then how 
about 2400m?
choice_data_list:
I guess that depends on how the race 
unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just barely making it, huh. Understood. 
Then in the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Not just the sprint and mile route, but 
going for the Triple Tiara as well. Is 
that what you mean?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think there's a chance.

text_block_list.text:
—The Triple Tiara. The 2,400m of the 
second leg, the Oaks, is the big hurdle, 
but if she can clear that, it's within 
reach.

The goal is the world stage. However, 
there seem to be many different paths we 
can choose to take us there.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara is one path. And if we 
were to take the mile/sprint route...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume standing in our way is, 
without a doubt—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeeeeeeeahh！！！！！！

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Pearl-san! Congratulations on 
entering the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
From now on, let's also do our best as 
race-mates together, let's SHOW!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Taiki! As a fellow classmate, I'll 
show you lots of love!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho...!!

Though she laughs boisterously, Seeking 
the Pearl knows full well. Yes—

—Taiki Shuttle. A cheerful gunslinger 
miler also born in America. She was...

That if I head down the sprint and mile 
route, she will be an absolute rival.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's no need to look so tense, 
Trainer. Taiki's talent is certainly 
terrifying, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Still, nothing is impossible for me. The 
higher the wall, the more worth there is 
in proving the possibilities. Wouldn't you 
agree?"

Seeking the Pearl was right. Her goal is 
to turn the impossible into reality. In 
other words—

If you don't challenge the impossible, 
dreams won't come true. Whether it's 
challenging the Triple Tiara, or facing 
Taiki Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, all you have to do is trust me. 
Believe from the bottom of your heart! And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Glory lies at the end of that path. Now, 
let us search for it. The pearl that 
shines in our future!
